question: What dark form is accessed by resorting to the place of the yoginī?
premises: One resorts to the place of the yoginī
A dark, black-colored form is present there
This form is the object of focus
inference: By resorting to the place of the yoginī, one accesses a dark, black-colored form.
plain_english: Having resorted to the place of the yoginī, one encounters the dark, black-colored form.
